goal: Speed up initial block download and chainstate reindexing
Read upcoming blocks from disk ahead of validation to overlap disk I/O with CPU work
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing speedups during initial block download and reindexing (andrewtoth)
Previous concerns regarding debug log spam and branch memory leaks have been resolved (fanquake, w0xlt)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because prefetching blocks asynchronously significantly speeds up block validation
Node operators see up to a 1.57x speedup for reindex-chainstate and 1.13x for initial sync
